releaseNotes:
• 🎛️ Complete 10-Option Video Action Bottom Sheet: Modern modal with colorful professional icons for Favourite, Add To Playlist, File Transfer, Lock in Private Folder, Convert to MP3, Share, Rename, Cut, Properties, and Delete
• 🔝 Top Bar & Down Bar Navigation: Unified TopAppBar with back/search/view-toggle and 5-tab Bottom Navigation (Home, Folders, My List, Private, Settings) across folder views and screens
• 🛡️ Crash Fix in Favorites (My List): Resolved duplicate key exception when videos exist in both Favorites and Watch History
• ⚪ Clean Modern White UI: Ultra-crisp background with high-contrast typography, duration thumbnail badges, and sleek overflow buttons
• 🎦 Cinematic Video Player & HDR+: Glassmorphic dock bar, glowing electric blue seeker line, left vertical brightness HUD, right vertical volume HUD, and hardware-accelerated HDR/HDR10+ decoding
